name: Kusozako Maou Shoujo Akari ~Ishukandaru e Youkoso!~
original_name: クソザコ魔王少女アカリ ～イシュカンダルへようこそ！～
source:
――Yatou Akari, an ordinary school girl attending an all-girls' school. Her grades are decent, engaging in club activities, and has a lot of friends. Perhaps because she has reached a certain age, in her room, on a spur of the moment, she masturbates. After climaxing with pleasure, she tirelessly opens her eyes and finds――

Not on her bed, not in her room, not even in the school dormitory, but a stiff stone paving, she sees a dimly lit place unfamiliar to her.

Wondering if this is a dream, at the moment when Akari tries to speak, she hears someone's voice, a strange figure appears before her.

"Ahhhhhh!? What!? Why!? Hold on. ......Eh? I? Have I mistaken?"

Shouting such things, the woman is clearly surprised and flustered.
Soft dark skin and long pointed ears. And the way she looks like she is wearing an underwear, Akari thinks that she sees something beautiful, while also thinking that this is a dream.

To see such a character that would appear only in manga and novels, she thinks, no, she must be thinking what an [i]otaku[/i] she is to have experience such dream.

Maybe because she still feels the afterglow of her climax, she is very tired.
She thinks that she should sleep until dinner time, so she closes her eyes again.

However.

"No! No! No! This can't be! Why? Moreover, a human? Beside, isn't this just a poor loser!"

Although she has closed her eyes, she can still hears, an obvious insult.
Yes, she is a human, but she is not poor and her shape is not bad.
Even her breasts are bigger than most people, not that fat as well.

Despite this being a dream, why does she have to take these insults?
Her body is listless, Akari does not have the energy to fight back, such a rude dream, she sighs and wonders when she would wake up.

But, the harsh words toward her do not stop, interweaving with the words she does not understand, the woman's insult continues.

And finally, her patience is at the limit, trying to fight back, Akari forces her tired body to wake up.

"Agh, enough! What the hell is wrong with......you?"

......The dream comes true.
However, everything looks strangely real and vivid.

She can feels in it her hands, the coldness of the stone paving.
Dust, mold, and smells really old too.
Since this is a dream, is it possible to experience all of these?
Such sensations make her sound weak, as she begins to feel impatience and suspicious, even anxiety kicks in.

"What's this?" "What's going on?" "Where is this place?"
"How do I get home?" "Is the elf in front of me real?"
"Eh? I was masturbating in my room, wasn't I?"
"Wait a minute, what? When I came, did I go somewhere?"

Obviously in a panic.
The afterglow of her climax instantly blows away, feeling pale, her brains filled with questions, a helpless frustration.

As if the make Akari even more confused, the voice of insult turns into a deep sigh, and languidly informs her.

"Sigh....... You have been chosen to become the [i]Maou[/i] of this world. If you don't want to die......If you want to go back to your world, do what I tell you, shitty human!"

"Huh? Huhhhhh!?"

――Will Akari be able to return to her original world? Or will she become the [i]Maou[/i] of this world?

Experience a girl who suddenly arrives at another world, getting raped by various species, grotesque-looking monsters, and demons, while she pants, and spreads her juices all over, in this sexual fantasy.

translation:
——夜藤朱莉，在女子学校读书的普通女生。成绩过得去，参加社团活动，朋友也很多。也许是到了对性好奇的年纪，她一时兴起，在自己房间里自慰。快感退去，她倦倦地睁开眼，却发现——

身下不是床，周围既不是自己的房间，也不是学校宿舍。她躺在坚硬的石板地上，四下昏暗，是个从没见过的地方。

正想着是不是在做梦，朱莉刚要开口，就听见了别人的声音，一个奇异的身影出现在眼前。

“啊啊啊？！什么？！为什么？！等等……咦？我？是我搞错了？”

女人嚷个不停，显然既吃惊又慌张。她有着深色的肌肤和尖尖的长耳朵，穿得像是只有内衣。朱莉一边觉得眼前的人漂亮，一边认定自己在做梦。

这种角色明明只会出现在漫画和小说里。竟会做这样的梦，自己究竟是有多[i]宅[/i]啊。

也许是刚才的疲倦还没散，她浑身乏力。干脆睡到晚饭时再起来吧，她想，于是又闭上了眼睛。

然而。

“不、不、不！这怎么可能！为什么？而且还是个人类？这不就是个彻头彻尾的废物吗！”

眼睛闭上了，那番明摆着骂她的话却听得一清二楚。她是人类没错，可她既不寒碜，身材也没那么糟，甚至比多数人丰满，又说不上胖。

就算在梦里，凭什么也要听人这样骂？朱莉浑身发懒，没力气回嘴，只好叹口气。这梦真没礼貌，到底什么时候才能醒啊。

可那女人依然没有停口，夹杂着朱莉听不懂的字眼，骂个没完。

终于，她忍无可忍，强撑着疲惫的身体坐起，准备还嘴。

“啊，够了吧！你到底有什么……毛病？”

……梦里的景象就在眼前。
然而，一切都鲜明得出奇，真实得古怪。

手掌能摸到石板冰凉的温度。
空气里有灰尘味、霉味，还有一股陈年旧物的气息。
如果真是梦，怎么会连这些都感觉得到？
朱莉的声音弱了下去。焦急、怀疑甚至不安，一齐涌了上来。

“这是什么？”“怎么回事？”“这里是哪儿？”
“我要怎么回家？”“面前这个精灵是真的？”
“咦？我刚才不是还在自己房间里自慰吗？”
“等一下，难道我在高潮的时候，跑到别的地方来了？”

她彻底慌了神。方才残留的快感顷刻消失，脸色也白了。一个接一个的问题塞满脑袋，她却无计可施。

像是嫌她还不够困惑，那个骂她的声音化成一声长叹，有气无力地告知她：

“唉……你被选中当这个世界的[i]魔王[/i]了。要是不想死…还想回自己的世界，就乖乖照我说的做，你这废物人类！”

“咦？咦——？！”

——朱莉能回到原来的世界吗？还是会成为这个世界的[i]魔王[/i]？

这部情色奇幻作品讲述了少女突然来到异世界，遭到各个种族的生物、形貌怪诞的怪物和恶魔强暴的经历，描写了她受侵害时的喘息与体液四溅的情形。
